content:
alex: Heads up — planning a small quant-profile bump + kernel flag tweak on the runtime tonight at 23:00 UTC. 30m window targeted. Canary on slice s-7 for first 10m, then roll 1 slice every 5m. Primary: raj, secondary: lina. I’ll kick off unless someone else wants it.

raj: Ack, I can be primary for the window and will watch the pager. ping me 5m before start.

lina: Ack for secondary. I’ll handle rollback execution and KV/cache sanity checks.

alex: CLIs I’ll run (canary -> staged):

```
# start canary on s-7
rctl rollout start --component=runtime-engine --quant-profile=qp-lite-v2 --kernel-flag=fast_attn_v2 --slice=s-7 --type=canary --owner=raj

# continue rolling, 1 slice every 5m
rctl rollout continue --rate=1/5m --slices=rest --confirm

# immediate rollback if needed
rctl rollout rollback --to=qp-lite-v1 --immediate
```

taylor: Can we bump kv_cache version in the config so old cached prefixes don't cause mismatches? If yes, do that in the canary slice before traffic shift.

maria: Smoke checklist (run automatically + manual quicks):
- 3x baseline inference probes (16 tokens) — 99p latency < 120ms
- 50 synthetic quality prompts against anchor set (compare outputs to baseline delta)
- Error rate < 0.05% (5xxs + runtime errors)
- Trace: ensure kv_cache_miss ratio doesn't spike > 3x

Quick probes:
```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.int.redwood/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN" -d '{"model":"runtime-engine","input":"smoke test prompt"}' | jq '{latency: .meta.latency_ms, err: .error}'
```

deploy-bot: Scheduled window created: 2026-03-17T23:00:00Z (23:00 UTC). Canary reservation: slice s-7. Incident channel auto-created: #eng-runtime-deploy-2176543210.

ops-bot: Reserved canary slice s-7 for 23:00-23:40 UTC. Locking autoscaler on affected slot groups during window.

raj: Will run the canary command and post the first green check (latency + error). Green criteria: 99p < 120ms, error rate < 0.05, sample quality pass >= 48/50.

lina: On rollback notes: if any of these happen -> immediate rollback
- error rate > 0.1% sustained for 2m
- 99p latency > 200ms
- KV cache errors spike > 5x
Command to rollback if triggered:
```
rctl rollout rollback --to=qp-lite-v1 --immediate --reason="canary-failure"
```
I’ll also tail kernel logs on the nodes: `sudo tail -n 200 /var/log/runtime/kernel.log | grep -i quant`.

taylor: Reminder: convert 23:00 UTC -> 16:00 PDT for folks in region.

alex: Great. Small ops notes:
- Disable background reclaims on slices during the window (ops-bot already locks it).
- Keep a 1GB buffer for kv_cache on the canary nodes.

maria: I'll run the synthetic quality set and post a short diff summary in the channel (pass / fail counts).

raj: If canary green at +10m I’ll trigger the staged roll with the rate above. I’ll post the rctl output in thread.

lina: I’ll be ready to execute rollback and confirm return to qp-lite-v1 health checks.

alex: All right — please react with :thumbsup: if you're on-call for this window.

maria: +1 :thumbsup:

taylor: +1 :thumbsup:

raj: +1 :thumbsup:

lina: +1 :thumbsup:

alex: Thanks — I’ll post start + end signals and a quick post-deploy sanity note ~45m after window closes.
